title: Women and the Church
tagline: The Church's teaching on the priesthood, Mary, and the dignity of women, with the women saints and doctors who show what it looks like.
whyItMatters: Many people think the Church treats women as lesser. The honest answer includes the Church's failures and its record of women who taught and led, alongside a reasoned account of why the priesthood is male.

mindset.tip: Listen for the hurt behind the question; some people have been treated badly by Church people (Galatians 3:28).
Acknowledge failures plainly. John Paul II did so in his Letter to Women.
Show the women of the Church: doctors, abbesses, martyrs and mothers. They answer the claim better than an argument alone.
Explain the priesthood as a question about sacramental signs, not about worth (CCC 1577; Ordinatio Sacerdotalis).
Admit that thoughtful Catholics ask these questions too, and that the Church has said the matter is settled.
